status.relayHint: Start the relay: npm run relay

source.title: Choose a data source
source.intro: Each mode feeds the same dashboard. Fields a source cannot provide are hidden or simplified.
source.gt7Description: Live telemetry from a PS5/PS4 in the same network, about 60 Hz.
source.consoleIpHint: PS5: Settings → Network → Connection status. Use 127.0.0.1 with npm run fake-gt7 to test without a console.
source.f1Description: Historical car data of a real driver from OpenF1, replayed as if live.
source.f1Offline: Could not reach OpenF1 through the relay.
source.mockDescription: Synthetic car on a fictional circuit with a field of rivals. Works anywhere.
source.replayDescription: Sessions recorded by the relay from GT7 or the demo.
source.noRecordings: No recordings yet. Every GT7 and demo session is recorded automatically.

driver.ggHint: Lateral vs longitudinal G, last 6 s
driver.derivedG: G derived from speed and yaw, not measured

car.zonesUnavailable: This source reports one temperature per tyre, not inner/middle/outer zones.

timing.noLaps: Laps appear here once the first one is completed.
timing.noField: This source has no data about other cars.
timing.sectorLegend: Purple: best of the session · Green: personal best when set · Yellow: slower
